statement: A compact isotrivial two-torus fibration over the affine line with K_X^A=f*O(D) has D<-A; consequently the ordinary-source collapsed target in a smooth S6 specialization is impossible
depends_on: E.2.10; E.2.12; constant marked torus periods; fibre integration of a smooth pluricanonical density; the proved L^(2/A) isolated-singularity estimate
R_items_and_Leads_used: R1; R4; R5 through the actual canonical-root identity
notes: Root and E full-source referee PASS. The proof allows 2/A<1 and uses actual fibre multiplicities. Together with E.2.14 it excludes all collapsed target normalizations; uniqueness of a noncollapsed interior completion and arbitrary deformation branches remain separate questions. No numerical experiment or unproved comparison theorem is used.
